bathAction.title: Wash armpits
bathAction.tooltip: Lift the arms and wash the armpits.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(lift)] one [npc.arm] and [npc.verb(wash)] [npc.her] [npc.armpit], slow enough to get the hair and the crease, then [npc.verb(switch)] sides. The smell of the day comes up with the water and then goes down the drain. [npc.speech(Both of them. I know they need it.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(lift)] [npc.her] [npc.arms] and [npc.verb(let)] the hot water run straight into [npc.her] [npc.armpits], washing them with a lazy hand. [npc.She] [npc.verb(hum)] at the relief of getting the sweat out. [npc.speech(Oh, that is the bit I could smell. Keep going.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(jam)] a hand into each [npc.armpit] in turn and [npc.verb(scrub)] until the skin is pink, then [npc.verb(rinse)] and [npc.verb(drop)] [npc.her] [npc.arms]. [npc.speech(Scrub it. I am not walking around smelling of that.)]
